newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt interbank rates rise in tight Sunday market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt interbank rates rise in tight Sunday market.

text.p: Interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose on Sunday in a slightly tight beginning-of-the-week private sector market, bankers said.
They said overnight rates were higher at between 10 1/8 and 10 3/16 percent from Thursday's 9 7/8 percent.
One-week rates also rose to 10 1/4 and 10 5/16 percent against 10 3/16 percent on Thursday.
Public sector banks continued to ask for a minimum 10 1/2 percent.
